description: A hangar of corrugated steel long enough to lose a conversation in, its sliding doors parked open on a rail packed solid with grit. Oil has printed the apron in overlapping black rings, and a row of chocks and a tug with one flat tyre sit where somebody last left them. Along the top of the doors, in letters six feet high and faded but still legible from the air: COLDWATER REGIONAL. The hangar floor is west; the runway is east.
name: Coldwater Regional Hangar
